task:
Dear <Ranger>! Look, they say the Maloq technology is poorly developed. But they have something to boast of in the war medicine area! Have you heard anything about drug "Swarokox"? This is a popular Maloq medicine that helps to cure blaster burns. Even the Haalians don't have such an effective remedy! Interesting is the fact that it is produced on only one planet in the Galaxy, that is on <ToPlanet> in the <ToStar> system. 

Unfortunately, the Maloqs refuse to sell it, you must be aware of their trading prejudices. Those hunting for "Swarokox" will have to reveal their courage and skills directly on the <ToPlanet> planet. We have already sent several agent s there but none of them came back.

Now we want you to complete this mission. If you bring as a sample of "Swarokox" in <Day> days, we will pay you <Money> cr! Is it a deal?
success: Oh, <Ranger>, you've met our expectations. This Maloq remedy will give an impulse to successful development of our race's science. A reward fee in the amount of <Money> cr has already been transferred to your account.
loc.1.0:
You were quick to find the Swarokox production facility office on <ToPlanet>. To your major surprise, it occupied a modest wooden house in the bosom of the forest. But the Maloqs' austerities have been known for a long time already.

- Hi, ranger <Ranger>! - an elderly-looking Maloq met you. - My name is Bargagra. There are rumours that you are after "Swarokox", aren't you? Heh. You aren't the first one. There were others before... But only a Maloq doctor can just pay for it to get some. So you'll have to pass a small test. Actually, to hunt <clr> swarokoks <clrEnd>, we prepare "Swarokox" out of their paws. Swarokoks have six paws but only the front right one possesses healing qualities.. If you collect <clr>10<clrEnd> such paws before midnight, I'll give you a small bottle of "Swarokox". Otherwise you'll just prove one more time that nobody but the Maloqs deserves such a remedy.
Swarokoks are rather ill-natured and scary creatures with good nose and ear. So take this ancient Maloq amulet that will help you to estimate the distance from the nearest swarokok. The truth is that galactic standards were not introduced in the times when it was created, so it will show distance using the ancient Maloq linear measure - <clr>grags<clrEnd>. I've forgotten long ago how many meters one grag is, but this is not important anyway - your goal is just to estimate the danger but not to compete. Also here is a brochure with swarokok hunting description and sign here for receiving safety education. Or do you really want to be instructed?
loc.5.0:
In the first place, you can entrap a swarokok with a net. Small curious animals, <clr>knashes<clrEnd>, appear to be the best lure for this. They can be caught in the neighbourhood. Also you may take <clr>a club or a knife<clrEnd> and fight with a swarokok. Blaster use is forbidden, this is one of the test terms. If a swarokok is not killed after the first blow, the fight becomes pretty bloody and the valuable paw is often injured.
You can recover if you eat <clr>a red flower <clrEnd> with oval petals. 
Your knife and club if often used can consequently go dull or break. If the knife is still sharp enough, you can make one more club. You won't do much with a dull knife, you know. 
Fighting without any weapon is almost a case of suicide. If a swarokok hasn't got at you too closely yet, you can either develop some of your skills or just have a rest and recover.

Now try to remember some short rules:
- The better your <clr>skill<clrEnd> is, the more effective your hunting with <clr>a knife<clrEnd> will be; the more <clr>strength<clrEnd> you have, the better your mastering of <clr>a club<clrEnd> is; and, the higher the level of your <clr>concealment<clrEnd> is, the easier your <clr>knash<clrEnd> hunting is.
- Swarokok can kill its enemy even if the latter is 100% strong, skilled or secretive. A hunter with a knash as a lure will get the best chances to win in such a fight. Then comes a hunter with a club. A hunter with a knife has the worst chances.
- One can fight barehanded but it's much more difficult and in most of the cases the paw is injured after such a fight.
- One can't make a net trap for a knash if a swarokok is closer than <clr>200<clrEnd> grags.
- One can't catch knashes or make a club if a swarokok is closer than <clr>220<clrEnd> grags.
- A club can't be made with the help of a barbed or nearly broken knife.
loc.8.0:
You entered the bosom of the forest surrounding the Bargagra's house. There is a lot of unknown trees, bushes and other plants all around you. Strange noises shed by the local fauna (and may be, flora as well) are torturing your ear. One must admit, this place appears to be rather scary for new comers. 

Alright, it's time to stick to business. Any ideas?
loc.8.1:
You approached the nearest tree, found a suitable limb, took out your knife and started making a <clr>club <clrEnd>. The job was rather painstaking and took much time. Moreover, after you finished, you found out that <clr>your knife turned a little<clrEnd>... 

What are you going to do next?
loc.8.2:
You looked about you. The first thing that attracted your attention, was <clr>a red flower<clrEnd> with oval petal. Very quickly you put it in your pocket. But then you considered it not to be enough and slipped off a couple more of <clr>unknown flowers <clrEnd>. "What if I'll need them one day?" - you thought. 

Next?
loc.8.3: You've spent a lot of time racketing about the forest and catching knashes. The progress is obvious: now there are [p11] knashes in your bag. Next?
loc.8.4:
After telling yourself off for a rash decision, you refused the idea of untimely hunting.

So what are you going to do?
loc.20.0:
You are standing in the middle of the gloomy forest surrounded by age-long trees stocks. 

What are you going to do?
loc.20.1:
You opened the brochure and found the following short rules there:

--------------------
- The better your <clr>skill<clrEnd> is, the more effective your hunting with <clr>a knife<clrEnd> will be; the more <clr>strength<clrEnd> you have, the better your mastering of <clr>a club<clrEnd> is; and, the higher level of <clr>concealment<clrEnd> you have, the easier your <clr>knash<clrEnd> hunting will be.
- A swarokok can kill its enemy even if the latter is 100% strong, skilled or secretive. A hunter with a knash as a lure will get the best chances to win in such a fight. Then comes a hunter with a club. A hunter with a knife has the worst chances.
- One can fight barehanded but it's much more difficult and in most of the cases the paw is injured after such a fight.
- One can't make a net trap for a knash if a swarokok is closer than <clr>200<clrEnd> grags.
- One can't catch knishes or make a club if a swarokok is closer than <clr>220<clrEnd> grags.
- A club can't be made with the help of a barbed or nearly broken knife.
--------------------

What are you going to do next?
loc.20.2: It took you rather long to make a club. Pluses: you made it. Minuses: your knife became dull and the swarokok came closer. Next?
loc.20.3: While you lay doing nothing, the swarokok was coming closer and closer. But your health and strength notably increased!
loc.21.0: It took you rather long to make a net trap for a swarokok. The process turned out to be very time-consuming. Now you need to put a knash into the trap and wait.
loc.22.0: You grasped the club and prepared for a single fight with a swarokok. The beast was so close that you could almost feel its breath on your face.
loc.23.0: You looked into a swarokok's fiery eyes, clutching your knife. Next?
loc.24.0:
Looking about you, you found several things that could be used as gymnasium pieces. A tree similar to cartenga with ripe fruits, a huge log on the ground and half wizened scrubs of crumpius. 

What are you going to do?
loc.24.1: You approached the huge log and tried to lift it. Suddenly a mad thought rushed through your mind "Why the hell am I doing it?". But then you quickly gathered yourself up and started training. In the end of the lesson you were as strong as to think of trying your <clr>strength<clrEnd> against Schwarz Sheneger, a famous Maloq bodybuilder who had carried the presidential elections on the <ToPlanet> planet due to his muscles only.
loc.24.2: After several lifts of the biggest in the neighbourhood log, your muscles began engorging with simply Maloq <clr>strength<clrEnd>. You were becoming stronger and stronger.
loc.24.3: After log lifting you felt as <clr>strong<clrEnd>, as to screw a swarokok's neck with your bare hands! However, a club is still better...
loc.24.4: You shook the tree stock, and the fruits rained down upon you. You were doing your best to escape them and in the end of the training you became so skilful in it that agent Smith, the main character from blockbuster "Matrix-49: Neo and Dominators", would envy your <clr>skill <clrEnd>. However, you didn't have much time to think about your concealment so your gliding skills degraded...
loc.24.5: In the beginning you were just successfully escaping the falling fruits, but then you learned to peel them on the run, and in the end you were as skilful as to squeeze juice and drink it while the forced fruit was falling down. What a fantastic <clr>skill<clrEnd>!
loc.24.6: You have trained with cartenga fruits to your heart's content. After this you felt that your <clr>skill<clrEnd> let you try and compete with Drevochan, the main character from sequel "Maloq armour - 15".
loc.24.7: Entering the crumpius bushes, you tried to move without touching any branch or prickle there. It took you rather long to train but in the end you felt that famous Chingachgook would be a fool to you if he competed in <clr>concealment<clrEnd> with you. However, you needed some rest after your training...
loc.24.8: Crumpius branches gave you much pain lashing across your face. Though there were more and more scratches appearing on it, you started producing less and less noise. At last you learned to move noiselessly at all - your <clr>concealment<clrEnd> became much better.
loc.24.9: After your training in the crumpius scrubs you noted with satisfaction that if knashes had been as skilled in <clr>concealment<clrEnd> as you were, nobody would have ever noticed them.
loc.25.0: There are many unknown fruits hanging around you and most of them look rather unpalatable. Will you try any of them?
loc.25.1:
You tried an unknown fruit. Some changes are obvious.

Will you try anything else?
loc.25.2: You ate a health flower and felt that all your wounds were healing. You wondered why the <FromPlanet> government needed just "Swarokox"? They should have sent you to bring health flowers!
loc.25.3:
You ate a strange flower and tried to trace any changes in you... Yes, something changed for sure... 

Will you try anything else?
loc.35.0: You didn't have to wait for a swarokok long. It appeared soon, nosed out a knash and jumped after it with complete abandon. Naturally, it got entrapped in the net immediately so you rushed out of your shelter and decided the battle with several blows. However, you didn't have much time to try and keep the net tear-free for the next use so it became complete garbage. But <clr>you got the paw<clrEnd>.
loc.35.1: A swarokok jumped from nowhere and charged at the poor knash. There were heard a menacing roar and contented champs. You securely left your shelter and when the swarokok noticed you all it could do was just floundering in the net and getting your deadly blows one after another.<clr>You got one more paw<clrEnd>. Of course, the swarokok's strength couldn't be compared to the tearing strength of the net so you could only be happy that those sad remains of the former trap saved your life.
loc.35.2: The swarokok approached the trap snuffing and looking about itself. It took the beast quite a while before it turned its head for the last time and charged at the knash. It even seemed to you that you heard its contented smocking. Soon after it was bursting the net with vain attempts to fetch away. You rushed out of your shelter and decided the battle with a couple of good blows. One can say that you successfully exchanged a good trap for <clr>a good paw<clrEnd>.
loc.36.0:
Unfortunately, <clr>the swarokok noticed you<clrEnd> before it charged at the knash into the trap. Now it stands just a meter away from you roaring menacingly with its tail fiercely lashed about.

Out of the corner of your eye you notice that the knash which had been desperately wangling managed to set itself free. Now you lost both the lure and the trap - a torn and tangled net was completely useless.

What are you going to do?
loc.36.1:
The swarokok approached the trap snuffing and looking about itself. It took the beast quite a while before it turned its head for the last time. It even seemed to you that you heard its contented smocking. And you really did but it smocked because it noticed a much tastier kill than just a small knash that had managed to tear the net and escape by that time.

<clr>You failed to hide <clrEnd> from the swarokok and now it stands in front of you roaring menacingly. What are you going to do?
loc.37.0: You decided to desert the battlefield. Well, that wasn't a bad decision either. However, you didn't have enough health and strength to compete with the swarokok in long distance race. When it caught up with you and charged at you from behind, it almost thrashed the life out of you. After giving you a good portion of beating and biting, it calmed down and proudly removed itself.
loc.38.0: Unfortunately, the swarokok didn't believe your simulation. It approached you, sniffed at you several times and jumped. You were bound to lose.
loc.39.0: Well, it looked like you were extremely lucky. Either the swarokok was dull or your <clr>concealment<clrEnd> skills were highly developed. The beast approached you, sniffed at you a couple of times, peed on your feet and silently disappeared in the darkness...
loc.40.0: You had been competing with the swarokok in race for a long time and still remained very strong. So at last the beast got tired and ran away with its tongue out.
loc.41.0: After you let the swarokok jump at you, you gave it a deadly blow on the head with your club. Fortunately, the latter turned out to be harder than the swarokok's scull. So <clr>the winner got the trophy<clrEnd>.
loc.41.1: It took you rather long punching yourself in the chest and roaring before the swarokok got furious enough and jumped at you. But you met it with your club and decided the battle. You were lucky not to injure the valuable <clr>paw<clrEnd>, which you put in your bag.
loc.41.2: You remained motionless playing with your club while the swarokok was lashing its tail on the ground. Finally, you had enough of it - the beast was not going to be the first to attack. Then you yelled "Garbyrghur tragradag!", which was the ancient Maloqs' hunting cry, and attacked the swarokok with your club atilt. It came so unexpectedly for the beast that it just stood still and one mighty blow on its scull decided the battle in your favour. <clr>One more paw<clrEnd>
loc.42.0: After you let the swarokok jump at you, you recollected all your strength and gave it a blow on the head with your club. Unfortunately, the blow was not strong enough and the swarokok crumpled you with all its weight. The further fight was long and unequal. You lost most of your strength but managed to kill the monster. However, <clr>the paw was completely injured<clrEnd>.
loc.42.1: You looked into the swarokok's eyes and realised that it wasn't just playing games. Suddenly the swarokok jumped. You met it with your club dabbing right between its eyes. However, when it reached you, your arm faltered and the swarokok just crumpled you with its weight. You lost most of your health and strength but managed to twist and strike the beast with your weapon. You could hardly stand up. Tottering, you were punching the dead body of the swarokok again and again. And when you came back, you realised that <clr>the paw was completely injured<clrEnd>.
loc.43.0: You waited until the swarokok jumped at you, then you suddenly rolled away and slashed it on the throat with your knife. The beast was agonising while you went on circling around it and slashing it again and again on the spots where you thought vital internals were. At last<clr>the swarokok's paw became your trophy<clrEnd>.
loc.43.1: You and the swarokok were moving in a round looking in each other's eyes. At last the swarokok's nerves snapped and it jumped at you. And you'd been expecting it! When the beast almost got you, you tipped over, raised your legs with it over you and slashed its throat with your knife. Your further actions didn't require much strength - the beast was bleeding and couldn't stand against you. The battle was decided. And the healing <clr>paw was placed into your bag <clrEnd>.
loc.43.2: As long as the swarokok refused to jump at you, you decided to attack yourself. In the beginning it seemed to you that you had made a wrong decision - the beast showed its fangs terribly gnashing them and roaring. But in the last moment when you had almost no chances left, the swarokok made a little mistake defending itself and that was enough for you to stick the knife right into the beast's heart with one clever hit and kill it. All you had to do then was <clr>to cut off the needed paw <clrEnd>.
loc.44.0: You tried to escape the swarokok's attack but failed - it caught you with its paw and stroke you down to the ground. It was going to pull you to pieces. But you managed to twist under the swarokok and slash it with the knife justifying your reputation of a good ranger. The fight was over soon, and the dead body of the beast fell down at your feet. Alas, the healing <clr>paw<clrEnd> was all bloody <clr>and completely useless<clrEnd>.
loc.44.1:
At last when the swarokok jumped, you momentarily fell on your back and tried to throw the beast over you. But it divined your manoeuvre and wouldn't let you. Lying on your back you were a perfect target for its fearful claws and fangs... 
Much of your blood was spilt on the <ToPlanet> ground but when the swarokok raised its poisonous paw for the final stroke, you recollected all your strength and met it with the knife. Such a wound made the beast yelp and run away. But it wasn't fast enough, wounded and exhausted after the fight, so you easily killed it. 
However, <clr>there was no chance for the paw to remain safe <clrEnd>.
loc.45.0:
You were sick and tired of swarokoks, knashes, knives and the rest of the stuff. You came back to the Bargagra's house and demanded your blaster back. The master had nothing against it, just sneered.
"Well, - he said, - really, it just convinced me once again that only a true Maloq can beat a swarokok. Good bye, <Ranger>. And never come back!"

<clr>Your mission was failed.<clrEnd>
loc.47.0: You recollected all the remains of your strength and stood against the swarokok barehanded. However, your <clr>strength, skill and concealment <clrEnd> were not enough for the quick victory over the dreadful beast. Two of you grappled rolling on the ground and none of you could beat the other. At last, feeling completely tired, you found out that you were lying on something hard. You seized that offhand weapon and hit the swarokok. Fortunately enough, that stroke turned out to be fatal for the beast. But by that time you felt as exhausted as never before, moreover, <clr>the paw lost its healing qualities <clrEnd>.
loc.47.1: It was clear from the very beginning that you shouldn't have behaved like that. The swarokok didn't even have to jump or roar, it just easily approached you and seized your neck with its fangs. It wasn't good for you, of course, you lost most of your health and strength. However, the beast's excessive self-confidence gave you one small chance and you didn't lose it. Your clever hit in the swarokok's nerve centre paralysed it. Your further actions were chaotic - you rained your blows on the beast and didn't bother to choose the proper weapon or the right spot to hit. The results were obvious - the swarokok was lying dead at your feet but the needed <clr>paw was completely injured <clrEnd> and couldn't be used.
loc.48.0: Recollecting all the remains of your strength, you decided to fight the swarokok barehanded. Weird forces must have helped you - your onset killed the swarokok and <clr>the valuable paw remained safe <clrEnd>. This great deed will live forever in Maloq manuscripts!
loc.48.1: Standing in front of the swarokok completely barehanded, all you could remember of was the ancient martial art <clr>kara-heh<clrEnd>, the main idea of which was to chose the right moment and shout "<clr>HEH<clrEnd>" in the enemy's face. As long as no other techniques came to your mind, you yelled "<clr>HEH<clrEnd>" right in the swarokok's nose. Either the technique was really effective, or the beast just tried to understand what you were doing but as the result you managed to strike the motionless swarokok down to the ground <clr>with one single blow <clrEnd> on the neck. Fortunately, <clr>the valuable paw remained safe <clrEnd>. After your deed the Maloqs from <ToPlanet> will spend a lot of time trying to develop the technique "<clr>HEH-KOK<clrEnd>" for production of "Swarokox".
loc.49.0: The swarokok stands right in front of you screwing up its eyes and staring at you. What are you going to do?
loc.54.0: While you tried to catch knashes producing much noise, the swarokok got quite close at you. Unfortunately, you just wasted your time - <clr>not a single knash<clrEnd> was caught. Perhaps, one should develop his <clr>skill<clrEnd> to hunt knashes...
loc.54.1: While you tried to catch knashes producing much noise, the swarokok got quite close at you. You managed to catch just <clr>one<clrEnd> knash. You lack either <clr>skill<clrEnd> or luck...
loc.54.2: While you tried to catch knashes producing much noise, the swarokok got quite close at you. But then you caught as much as <clr>two<clrEnd> knashes! Time for hunting.
loc.57.0: According to the Maloq archival manuscripts, running against a swarokok without a good club and a couple of knashes in the pocket is equal to fighting with three pirates with just one photon. Are you sure of what you are doing?
loc.63.0: You dodged in the forest and laid up waiting for the swarokok. At last it appeared. Its fiery eyes were seen through the depths of the forest and its nose moved from side to side discerning unfamiliar smells. Alas, you <clr>didn't have enough <clrEnd> skill and concealment, and the swarokok spotted you. Now it's standing right in front of you and fiercely lashing its tail on the ground. You have only several seconds to make the right decision.
loc.63.1: You dodged in the forest and laid up waiting for the swarokok. At last it appeared. Its fiery eyes were seen through the depths of the forest and its nose moved from side to side discerning unfamiliar smells. Fortunately, you had <clr>enough<clrEnd> skill and concealment to remain unseen so you recollected your breath and got back to your hunting.
loc.66.0:
- It seems to me that I forgot my happy amulet in the spaceship! - you hawed and dashed out of the Bargagra's house. The Maloq yager's Homeric laughter was following me. Well, his opinion of non-Maloqs had just been confirmed...

<clr>Your mission failed<clrEnd>, but you are alive!

param.0.crit: Your health was deeply exhausted. Suddenly you felt sharp pain, fell down and can't even move your finger now. Local beasts are going to have a nourishing meal today.
param.1.crit: К сожалению, силы Вас полностью оставили. Вы могли только ползти, создавая много шума. Сварококи быстро вас услышали, и Вам оставалось только чуствовать слабеющим сознанием, как поедают Ваши останки.
param.4.crit:
At last, having collected <clr>10<clrEnd> paws, you went out of the gloomy forest feeling great relief and turned back to the Bargagra's house. The Maloq looked at you with a frown and said: 
- Welcome back, <Ranger>! Never expected anybody but a native-born Maloq to be able to pass this test. Well, you gained your end. Here is your "Swarokox", you deserved it.

Hurrah! You got what you were after. 
But your mission is not complete yet! Now you must take "Swarokox" and fly back to <FromPlanet> by <Date>!
param.7.crit:
Unfortunately, you failed to collect 10 paws before midnight and meet the test terms. You've got nothing left to do but shift away from the forest and get back to your spaceship skirting the Bargagra's house.

<clr>Your mission is failed.<clrEnd>
